archetypes.name: dyn-tmpdir-lint-baseline
archetypes.rationale: New AST lint plus multi-site tmpdir normalization can miss edge cases in occurrence identity or empty-argv fallbacks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect lint_tmpdir_arg_env_fallback.py detection of validate_tmpdir and Path(args.tmpdir), the shrink-only baseline row for bgjob _build_spec, and start_main IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR fallback. Confirm the five refactored Path sites no longer match the unsafe AST shape while preserving prior semantics, and that empty or omitted --tmpdir cannot resolve to Path(""). Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
